stories.title: Empowering a sustainable future: International Gas Union summit to be held in Hong Kong this October

en.title: Empowering a sustainable future: International Gas Union summit to be held in Hong Kong this October
en.summary: The International Gas Union Council 2026 and sustainability summit will take place in Hong Kong this month, providing a platform for leaders to discuss global energy security and price trends amid geopolitical uncertainties.

stories.title: CFA中国之队·重庆国际足球邀请赛：中国队一胜三负收官

en.title: CFA China Team Chongqing International Football Invitational: China team finishes with one win and three losses
en.summary: China's national football team concluded the 2026 CFA Chongqing International Football Invitational with a 0-1 loss to Tajikistan, ending the tournament with a record of one win and three defeats.

stories.title: Hong Kong approves average fee hikes of up to 4.75 per cent for non-public schools

en.title: Hong Kong approves average fee hikes of up to 4.75 per cent for non-public schools
en.summary: Hong Kong's Education Bureau approved tuition fee increases for non-public schools in the 2026-27 academic year, with private schools authorized to raise fees by up to 4.75 per cent, semi-private schools by 4.07 per cent, and international schools by 4 per cent.

stories.title: 国际货币基金组织：对冲基金快速扩张或放大市场风险

en.title: International Monetary Fund: rapid expansion of hedge funds may amplify market risks
en.summary: The IMF warned that rapidly expanding hedge fund assets could amplify price misalignments and liquidity pressures during market volatility, potentially triggering systemic financial risks if hit by severe shocks.

stories.title: 4 Indonesian seamen kidnapped by Somali pirates return home

en.title: 4 Indonesian seamen kidnapped by Somali pirates return home
en.summary: Four Indonesian sailors held hostage by Somali pirates for over five months returned home after being rescued from a hijacked oil tanker. Maritime police from Somalia's Puntland region freed 17 crew members from the vessel, though five crew members were killed during the incident.

stories.title: 以色列政府发出旅行警告 提醒海外公民防范潜在安全风险

en.title: Israeli government issues travel warning to alert overseas citizens to potential security risks
en.summary: Israel's prime minister's office warned citizens abroad to heighten security awareness ahead of the third anniversary of conflict escalation on October 7, citing risks of potential attacks and demonstrations.

stories.title: WTT中国大满贯赛：王曼昱晋级16强 中国选手陈熠三线全胜

en.title: WTT China Grand Slam: Wang Manyu advances to round of 16, Chinese player Chen Yi undefeated across three events
en.summary: At the 2026 WTT China Grand Slam in Beijing, Wang Manyu defeated Indian player Batra 3-1 to reach the women's singles round of 16. Chen Yi won all matches across women's singles, women's doubles, and mixed doubles to advance.

stories.title: 《只此青绿》千场纪念在北京上演 足迹已达海内外近90城

en.title: Dance drama "Only Green Remains" marks 1,000 performances with Beijing premiere
en.summary: The dance drama "Only Green Remains" celebrated its 1,000th performance with a show at Beijing's National Aquatics Centre. The production has toured nearly 90 cities across China and internationally.

stories.title: 安徽“千年矾都”工业遗产蝶变文旅新地标

en.title: Anhui's "Thousand-Year Alum Capital" Industrial Heritage Transforms into New Cultural Tourism Landmark
en.summary: Industrial heritage sites in Anhui's historic alum-producing region are being redeveloped into cultural and tourism attractions.

stories.title: UK police arrest seventh man linked to security incident at US-run airbase

en.title: UK police arrest seventh man linked to security incident at US-run airbase
en.summary: British police arrested a 22-year-old man in London on suspicion of a terror offense related to a security incident at RAF Fairford, a US military base. This is the seventh arrest connected to an alleged plot authorities have linked to Iran.

stories.title: 拉脱维亚总统委托总理组建新内阁

en.title: Latvian president tasks prime minister with forming new cabinet
en.summary: Latvia's president has tasked incumbent Prime Minister Andris Kubergs with forming a new government after his party alliance won the most parliamentary seats in recent elections. The president aims for cabinet completion by November.

stories.title: 中国商务部回应法德要求欧盟强化贸易防御等保护主义工具

en.title: China's commerce ministry responds to French-German call for EU to strengthen trade defense and protectionist tools
en.summary: China's commerce ministry stated that protectionist measures cannot enhance competitiveness and that decoupling or breaking supply chains would be counterproductive for all parties involved.

stories.title: Hong Kong land sale stuns market as HK$4.3b bid hits 5-year Kowloon high

en.title: Hong Kong land sale stuns market as HK$4.3b bid hits 5-year Kowloon high
en.summary: Kerry Properties purchased a residential land plot in Ho Man Tin for HK$4.31 billion, marking the highest price for a Kowloon residential site in nearly five years. The sale price reflects strong developer confidence in luxury home demand.

stories.title: As China’s AI race accelerates, ‘model fatigue’ becomes the next challenge

en.title: As China's AI race accelerates, 'model fatigue' becomes the next challenge
en.summary: Multiple major technology companies released new artificial intelligence models within hours in September, including Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6, Anthropic's Opus 5.5, and OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna models. The rapid release pace is creating challenges for executives and developers attempting to track developments.

stories.title: China’s Transsion, Africa’s top phone maker, targets US$500 million Hong Kong listing

en.title: China's Transsion, Africa's top phone maker, targets US$500 million Hong Kong listing
en.summary: Shenzhen Transsion Holdings, which makes Africa's best-selling phones, is launching a Hong Kong share offering this week to raise up to US$500 million, with listing targeted for October 15. The company already trades in Shanghai with a market capitalisation of 62 billion yuan.

stories.title: Mox, BOCHK, ZA Bank and Citibank apps land among Asia-Pacific’s 10 best, study says

en.title: Mox, BOCHK, ZA Bank and Citibank apps land among Asia-Pacific's 10 best, study says
en.summary: Banking applications from Mox Bank, Bank of China Hong Kong, ZA Bank and Citibank Hong Kong ranked among the top 10 in Asia-Pacific according to an assessment by Sia consulting firm evaluating 145 banking apps across functionality and user experience.

stories.title: Hong Kong’s Hermitage Capital stays devoted to top-tier tech stocks amid jitters

en.title: Hong Kong's Hermitage Capital stays devoted to top-tier tech stocks amid jitters
en.summary: Hong Kong-based Hermitage Capital is continuing its global investment strategy in frontier technology companies despite market volatility, deploying its US$1.5 billion fund across artificial intelligence, semiconductors and robotics primarily in the US and China.
